summary: MicroCloud Hologram Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that CEO and director Guohui Kang resigned effective April 29, 2026, with no disagreement cited. The Board immediately appointed Haiyan Zhang as CEO and director to fill the vacancy. This is an abrupt, forced departure that constitutes the event itself, not a routine meeting notice or proxy circular. No deal terms, advisor, or premium apply. The filing explicitly states the resignation was not due to any operational disagreement. Watch for any subsequent regulatory filings or strategic shifts under new leadership.
